scope: Four independently small defects whose product question was decided 2026-10-17: (1) blank/whitespace leaver name in the 'left the group' row, (2) unsent backup dirty mark lost on early reload, (3) local-data wipe sends no cross-tab account-changed notice, (4) share contact card shows the generic retry error on a signer/identity pubkey mismatch.

behavior.leave_row: Display chain: embedded name -> cached profile nickname -> truncated npub; empty/whitespace at any link counts as absent. Value returned untrimmed when non-blank. Sibling announcements (canceller, invite lifecycle, rename, admitted, call) keep their existing '??' chain.
behavior.backup_dirty: Stored value is '<immediate|debounced>:<fresh token>' written on every mark (immediate sticky). publishScheduledBackup reads the token when it begins and, on publishBackup ok, removes the key only if it still equals that token (compare-and-clear; shared across tabs). Failure, connect failure and restore-pending pause keep it. Replay on scheduler activation unchanged; resetAllData removes the key unconditionally.
behavior.account_changed: resetAllData is async: removes localStorage keys, AWAITS the IndexedDB clears (allSettled; a rejecting clear is logged), THEN posts {type:'account-changed'}; the Danger Zone handler awaits it before window.location.reload(). NostrIdentityContext.replaceIdentity posts the notice via postAccountChangedIfSwitched when the pubkey really changed (case-insensitive), after saveStoredIdentity. _app.tsx installs the reload receiver; a burst reloads once; the posting tab never receives its own message.
behavior.share_card_mismatch: contactCard.ts raises SignerPubkeyMismatchError (message unchanged) from both encodeCard and encodeCardV2 guards; shareCard.resolveShareCardError maps it (instanceof, never message text) to profile.shareCardSignerMismatchError (exact en/de strings from the report); every other failure keeps profile.shareCardError.

constraints: No new publish of profile data; backup timing only (privacy invariant untouched)
localStorage flag carries only the word immediate|debounced; the cross-tab message carries no data
Every localStorage access in the new dirty-mark module is try/catch wrapped
All new UI strings in both en and de in i18n.ts, read via useCopy
No jsdom/@testing-library: components tested through exported pure functions
non_goals: Connect-time rejection of a mismatched NIP-46/NIP-07 signer (owner question)
Multi-tab coherence beyond the account-changed notice (single active tab / invalidation design)
Applying the blank-name rule to the sibling announcements
NIP-46 connect with a different pubkey (owner question); unload re-mark after a wipe; old-key empty-snapshot publish during unload (backlog finding)
notes: The report names app/pages/settings.tsx handleOpenShareCard; the share dialog actually lives in app/src/components/contacts/ShareContactCard.tsx (extracted earlier), which is what was changed. The report's 'storage wipe path' is storage.resetAllData (used by the Danger Zone wipe). The e2e AC-MEMBERS-2 wait was placed in the 'USER_A sees USER_B in the member list before the leave' step (member-item card must contain 'Bob', plain retrying toContainText), i.e. before Bob leaves, because the announcement test itself already retries and the profile must propagate beforehand.
remediation_round_1: Reviewer/Codex high: account-changed posted before fire-and-forget IDB clears, sender reload could abort them; VQ-3 gap: replaceIdentity (mnemonic restore) posted nothing; Codex medium: per-tab markSeq vs shared key; stale 'CURRENTLY UNUSED' comment.
